scope: Review of the current working tree, including 39 pre-existing modified compiler files; generated-state cleanup only, with no compiler fixes or acceptance-counter changes.
direction: The layered IR/backend architecture and differential tests are useful. Fix the reproduced wrong-code and distinguish skipped rows from tested rows before further frontier expansion. Prefer exported type/layout facts to additional nominal-name rules.

findings.title: Aggregate loads preserve an address rather than a value snapshot
findings.trigger: Load a Range containing [7,13]; write 99 to its first field through an alias; store the previously loaded aggregate to another address.
findings.cause: lowerTypedLoad records the source pointer, and lowerTypedStore/lowerTypedAggregateCopy only reads its fields at the later store.
findings.repair: Materialize the aggregate value at the AIR load, or require a verified proof that the source cannot change before every use.

findings.title: Optional pointer checks compare the container address
findings.trigger: Use is_null_ptr with a valid pointer to an optional pointer whose stored value is null.
findings.cause: is_null_ptr shares the value-form lowering; the generic pointer case emits icmp against the operand address without loading its optional value. The same path also handles is_non_null_ptr.
findings.repair: Distinguish value and pointer opcodes and load the payload or representation tag through the pointer, preserving volatile semantics.

findings.title: Skipped candidate rows receive success credit
findings.evidence: The loop increments lowered, object and native-link counters for each skipped candidate. The summary omits start_index and has no skipped-row counter or evidence/provenance check.
findings.impact: A window run can resemble full-prefix proof even though earlier rows were not tested against the current source. This review did not run or certify the 785-row prefix.
findings.repair: Count skipped rows separately, report the tested window, and disallow synthetic credit in acceptance summaries.

findings.title: Nominal-name exceptions continue to grow
findings.evidence: The pending diff adds about 2935 lines across 39 files, including about 654 lines of aggregate facts and 183 lines of enum facts. Several type rules accept basenames or suffixes before consulting generic exported layout information.
findings.impact: The frontier is becoming dependent on compiler-internal names; row coverage alone is weak evidence of generality.
findings.repair: Make compiler-exported facts authoritative, validate conflicts and layout/ABI boundaries, and batch new support by semantic capability with adversarial execution tests.
